source_name: MSE SEI-Net RSS feed (RSS известувања од СЕИ-Нет)
why_relevant: Machine-readable, dated, issuer-tagged feed of every SEI-Net filing. Confirmed to carry bank filings (e.g. УНИ Банка АД Скопје 'Јавен повик за собрание', 21.8.2026). This is the ideal ingestion spine for the whole cell.

source_name: Македонска берза АД Скопје — official site (Macedonian Stock Exchange)
why_relevant: Operator of the market and the publisher of listed-bank issuer profiles, exchange news, listing decisions, watch list, and the SEI-Net relay. Root node for the entire cell.

source_name: MSE — Најнови вести / Latest exchange news
why_relevant: Exchange-authored news: non-trade share transfers of bank stock, bond listing decisions, buybacks, suspensions — events that never appear on a bank's own IR page.

source_name: MSE issuer profile — Комерцијална банка АД Скопје (KMB)
why_relevant: Per-issuer hub: audited and unaudited financial statements, quarterly income statements, prospectus download, management, SEI-Net announcements for the largest domestically-owned bank.

source_name: MSE issuer profile — НЛБ Банка АД Скопје (TNB)
why_relevant: NLB Banka is a heavyweight MBI-10 constituent (~14.7% index weight per public sources); its MSE issuer page carries statements, assembly notices and prospectus material distinct from NLB Group IR.

source_name: MSE issuer profile — УНИ Банка АД Скопје (Universal Investment Bank)
why_relevant: Confirmed active filer: perpetual-bond listing decision and a 2026 shareholder-assembly public call ('Јавен повик за собрание') seen in the SEI-Net feed. Good example of a smaller bank using the exchange for capital-instrument disclosures.

source_name: MSE issuer profiles — remaining listed banks (Стопанска банка STB, Халкбанк, Шпаркасе, ТТК Банка, Централна кооперативна банка, Развојна банка)
why_relevant: Completes bank coverage of the exchange. Slug pattern /mk/issuer/{name}-ad-skopje is confirmed for KMB, TNB and UNI, so remaining bank slugs are highly likely to follow it — but each must be resolved via MSE site search rather than assumed.

source_name: MSE — Правила за котација (Listing Rules) and rulebooks
why_relevant: Defines WHAT listed banks must disclose, on what deadline, and the 'watch list' mechanism for non-compliant issuers. Essential for interpreting the disclosure stream and for detecting when an expected filing is missing.

source_name: MSE — Корпоративно управување / issuers reporting on the Corporate Governance Code
why_relevant: Bank-by-bank corporate-governance compliance reports (ККУ) — governance, board composition and comply-or-explain statements not present elsewhere.

source_name: MSE — Финансиски извештаи / Financial statements publication area
why_relevant: Aggregated repository of issuer financial statements (incl. banks) submitted to the exchange — the earnings backbone for this cell, in structured periodic form.

source_name: Комисија за хартии од вредност на РСМ (KHV / Securities and Exchange Commission)
why_relevant: The capital-market regulator: approves prospectuses and share/bond emissions (including bank capital raises), licenses participants, and publishes decisions. Multilingual (MK/AL/EN).

source_name: KHV — Месечни извештаи (Monthly regulator reports)
why_relevant: Each monthly report enumerates the Commission's actual decisions: approved share emissions, prospectus approvals, licence changes, supervisions and sanctions. Confirmed content structure via a 2012 issue. This is the systematic record of bank capital-raising approvals.

source_name: KHV — Регистри на учесници (Participant registers, incl. Овластени банки, Депозитарни банки, Друштва со посебни обврски за известување)
why_relevant: Authoritative actor map: which banks hold broker/custody/depository licences, and which joint-stock companies carry special reporting obligations. Snowballs into further entity-level source discovery.

source_name: KHV — Регулатива / Закон за проспекти и обврски за транспарентност за издавачите на хартии од вредност
why_relevant: The prospectus/transparency law defines issuer disclosure duties and periodic-reporting deadlines — the legal spine that makes this whole cell a predictable, calendarable stream. Related: Закон за хартии од вредност (consolidated text).

source_name: Централен депозитар за хартии од вредност АД Скопје (CDHV / CSD)
why_relevant: Registry of securities and holders; publishes shareholders holding above 5%, emission records and non-trade transfers. Reveals bank ownership changes independently of the issuer's own announcements. Also itself an MSE-listed issuer (symbol CDHV).

source_name: SEINet mobile app (iOS / Android push alerts)
why_relevant: Official MSE app pushing every new price-sensitive disclosure. Confirms SEI-Net has a low-latency notification channel and hints at an underlying API worth probing for structured collection.

source_name: MSE — MBI-10 index composition and symbol history
why_relevant: Index membership and weights show which listed banks are market-relevant (STB and TNB are MBI-10 constituents per public sources), letting the collector prioritise disclosure monitoring by materiality.

source_name: MSE годишни извештаи за работа (Exchange's own annual reports)
why_relevant: Annual narrative on listing activity, new issuers, turnover and disclosure-compliance — useful long-run context and a pointer to structural changes in the disclosure regime.

source_name: Pari.com.mk — capital-market trade press (secondary relay of KHV/MSE decisions)
why_relevant: Reports KHV session decisions (e.g. approval of a second share emission) and MSE/SEI-Net changes in narrative form, often faster to find than the primary PDF and useful for backfilling context and dates.

source_name: MSE Repository — direct PDF object store (prospectuses, objavi, reports)
why_relevant: Bank prospectuses and announcement PDFs are served from a predictable /Repository/ path (e.g. Komercijalna Banka prospectus). A high-yield harvesting surface once filenames are enumerated from the HTML pages that link them.

source_name: MSE English-language mirror (/en/ tree)
why_relevant: The exchange publishes an English mirror of issuer pages and news, useful for cross-lingual entity matching and for downstream analysts who do not read Macedonian. Coverage is typically thinner than the MK tree — MK remains authoritative.

source_name: Македонска банкарска асоцијација (MBA) — official site
why_relevant: The national banking association; publishes announcements (соопштенија), assembly decisions, position statements, ESG/green-finance briefings and sector-level commentary that individual banks do not issue separately. Bilingual mk/en site with a parallel /w/en/ tree.

source_name: MBA — Members directory (банки, штедилници, институции)
why_relevant: Single-page enumeration of the entire regulated deposit-taking sector: ~13-14 banks, 2 savings houses (Штедилница Можности, Штедилница ФУЛМ) plus KIBS AD Skopje (clearing/interbank systems) and Македонско кредитно биро. This is the seed actor list for every downstream A1 disclosure crawl.

source_name: SKIBOR — MBA interbank reference rate portal
why_relevant: Association-operated benchmark rate portal (Skopje Interbank Offered Rate) with panel/reference-bank list and rate board rules. Both a time-series data source and a pointer identifying which banks are active in the interbank money market.

source_name: MBA — Собрание и комисии (Assembly and standing commissions)
why_relevant: Lists MBA's permanent working bodies — payment systems, information security, risk management, liquidity, AML, document processing, securities, HR. The payment-systems and information-security commissions are the exact fora where card/ATM/e-banking/technology-vendor topics surface, and the named delegates map bank-side decision makers.

source_name: MBA — Activities / events / announcements feed
why_relevant: Rolling stream of association press releases, conference and event materials (ESG and sustainable finance, green economy, European Money Quiz), plus EBF (European Banking Federation) linkage. Event agendas and speaker lists routinely reveal vendor sponsors and bank project owners.

source_name: MBA — Macroeconomic and banking-system data section (MEDBSRNM)
why_relevant: Association-curated macroeconomic and banking-system indicators. Useful as a pre-aggregated sector series and as a cross-check against NBRNM statistics; also indicates which indicators the industry itself considers headline.
